authorship: Codex source-level reviewed off-policy recipes, not model rollouts. Distinct production symbols on one shared upstream snapshot.

tasks.trigger: Set one float formatter and render two fields.
tasks.wrong: The setter stores None instead of the supplied formatter in each field channel. Reversing field iteration is not itself the demonstrated defect.
tasks.causal: Restore field-to-formatter propagation and the empty dictionary reset contract.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1.234,2.345]);t.float_format='.2'
value=t.get_string();print('float_channels',t.float_format,value)
assert t.float_format=={'a':'.2','b':'.2'} and '1.23' in value and '2.35' in value

tasks.trigger: Export only the second column as CSV.
tasks.wrong: The header branch is inverted so selected data and all-column header have different cardinality.
tasks.causal: Use the selected fields for the header whenever projection is enabled.
tasks.observation:
import csv,io
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1,2])
value=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(t.get_csv_string(fields=['b']))));print('csv_projection',value)
assert value==[['b'],['2']]

tasks.trigger: Export only the second field as JSON with its header.
tasks.wrong: The selected-fields condition takes the all-field header branch.
tasks.causal: Align the JSON header projection with the existing row-object projection.
tasks.observation:
import json
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1,2])
value=json.loads(t.get_json_string(fields=['b']));print('json_projection',value)
assert value==[['b'],{'b':2}]

tasks.trigger: Add a column of matching length to an existing one-row table.
tasks.wrong: The shape acceptance condition is inverted, rejecting valid columns while entering the mutation path for mismatches.
tasks.causal: Accept matching dimensions and retain rejection of incompatible dimensions.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a']);t.add_row([1]);t.add_column('b',[2])
print('rectangular_column',t.field_names,t.rows)
assert t.field_names==['a','b'] and t.rows==[[1,2]]

tasks.trigger: Request CSV and text through the format dispatcher.
tasks.wrong: Branches for text, JSON and CSV were removed, so supported format requests raise ValueError.
tasks.causal: Restore the dispatch branches and pass keyword options to the selected real consumer.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1,2])
value=t.get_formatted_string('csv',fields=['b']);print('routed_output',repr(value))
assert value==t.get_csv_string(fields=['b']) and t.get_formatted_string('text')==t.get_string()

tasks.trigger: Grow unequal content widths to a configured minimum table width.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite distributes extra width equally instead of scaling content widths proportionally, with different remainder allocation.
tasks.causal: Restore proportional scaling of content widths after accounting for borders and per-column padding.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row(['x','abcdefghi']);t.min_table_width=30
value=t.get_string();print('proportional_widths',t._widths,value)
assert t._widths==[2,21] and all(len(line)==30 for line in value.splitlines())

tasks.trigger: Select the first two rows with legacy slice-before-sort enabled.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite sorts the full list before slicing in both branches, and also changes sort_key input shape.
tasks.causal: Restore legacy slice-before-sort versus current sort-before-slice ordering, preserving the original decorated-key contract.
tasks.observation:
import csv,io
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a']);t.add_rows([[3],[1],[2]])
legacy=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(t.get_csv_string(sortby='a',end=2,oldsortslice=True))))
current=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(t.get_csv_string(sortby='a',end=2))))
print('slice_order',legacy,current,t.rows)
assert legacy==[['a'],['1'],['3']] and current==[['a'],['1'],['2']] and t.rows==[[3],[1],[2]]

tasks.trigger: Render a title above a two-column table with borders enabled.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite returns only the title line and drops the upper frame line in the title block.
tasks.causal: Restore the title block with the frame surrounding its centered content before the column header frame.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1,2]);value=t.get_string(title='T');lines=value.splitlines()
print('title_frame',value)
assert lines[:3]==['+-------+','|   T   |','+---+---+']

tasks.trigger: Rename columns after assigning different alignment settings.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite looks up old alignment by new-name identity rather than old-to-new column position.
tasks.causal: Transfer alignment and vertical alignment from each prior field to its positional replacement.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.align['a']='l';t.valign['b']='b';t.field_names=['x','y']
print('renamed_alignment',t.align,t.valign)
assert t.align['x']=='l' and t.valign['y']=='b'

tasks.trigger: Center even-width content in an odd-width cell, and justify text wider than its cell.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite allocates the odd extra space to the wrong side for even content and truncates overwide text.
tasks.causal: Restore parity-sensitive centering and preserve source content when padding is nonpositive.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable();center=t._justify('ab',5,'c');wide=t._justify('abcdef',3,'l')
print('cell_padding',repr(center),repr(wide))
assert center=='  ab ' and wide=='abcdef'

tasks.trigger: Override top corner junctions for one rendering call.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite obtains junctions from instance getters instead of the merged per-call options.
tasks.causal: Use the selected options at the rule consumer so call-local corner overrides are honored.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a']);t.add_row([1]);value=t.get_string(top_left_junction_char='L',top_right_junction_char='R')
print('call_local_junctions',value)
assert value.splitlines()[0]=='L---R' and t.top_left_junction_char=='+'

tasks.trigger: Format LaTeX with border disabled and vertical-rules mode ALL.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite emits alignment bars whenever vrules is ALL, ignoring the border and preserve_internal_border conjunction.
tasks.causal: Use the complete border-option contract when constructing the LaTeX tabular alignment channel.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable,VRuleStyle
t=PrettyTable(['a','b']);t.add_row([1,2]);value=t.get_latex_string(format=True,border=False,vrules=VRuleStyle.ALL)
print('latex_border_contract',repr(value))
assert value.startswith('\\begin{tabular}{cc}\r\n')

tasks.trigger: Paginate three data rows into two-row pages.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite slices already rendered physical lines, splitting frames and headers instead of data-row ranges.
tasks.causal: Paginate row spans and render each page independently with its header and frame.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a']);t.add_rows([[0],[1],[2]]);value=t.paginate(page_length=2);pages=value.split('\f')
print('row_pages',repr(value))
assert len(pages)==2 and all('| a |' in p for p in pages) and '| 0 |' in pages[0] and '| 1 |' in pages[0] and '| 2 |' in pages[1]

tasks.trigger: Call the single-table import API with two tables.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite returns the first table and silently accepts multiple tables.
tasks.causal: Retain the single-table cardinality contract and informative ValueError feedback.

tasks.trigger: Replace a callback in the supplied formatter mapping after assigning it.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite copies the mapping, so later caller changes no longer reach rendering.
tasks.causal: Preserve the existing shared-reference contract of the formatter mapping.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a']);mapping={'a':lambda n,v:'old'};t.custom_format=mapping;mapping['a']=lambda n,v:'new';t.add_row([1]);value=t.get_string()
print('formatter_reference',t.custom_format is mapping,value)
assert t.custom_format is mapping and 'new' in value and 'old' not in value

tasks.trigger: Insert the first row into a table with no explicit field names and render it.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite assigns _field_names directly, skipping alignment setup performed by the field_names setter.
tasks.causal: Initialize implicit names through the real property setter so rendering receives complete per-field state.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable();t.add_row([1,2]);value=t.get_string()
print('implicit_field_state',t.field_names,t.align,value)
assert t.field_names==['Field 1','Field 2'] and t.align['Field 1']=='c' and t.align['Field 2']=='c'

tasks.trigger: Construct two columns with one float formatter and render data.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite writes raw kwargs to underscored attributes rather than using the property setter that expands field configuration.
tasks.causal: Restore constructor-to-setter propagation before the renderer consumes the per-field formatter mapping.
tasks.observation:
from prettytable import PrettyTable
t=PrettyTable(['a','b'],float_format='.2');t.add_row([1.234,2.345]);value=t.get_string()
print('constructor_formatter_channels',t.float_format,value)
assert t.float_format=={'a':'.2','b':'.2'} and '1.23' in value and '2.35' in value
